acceptanceCriteria: Each listed shape has a fixture test that now resolves (finding or CLEAN) instead of UNKNOWN
Login-helper names are configurable through declared project configuration, not hardcoded
Bindings are scoped per test so a key rebound in another test no longer yields actor-key-ambiguous
body: Residual of V1-1770 (PR #1121, GitHub #1115), which delivered the ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED analysis in internal/testsource/actor_auth*.go for Rails + CanCanCan with Playwright request.<verb>(literal path). Each of these currently yields UNKNOWN: fetch() and page navigation requests (only request.<verb>(literal) is read); load_and_authorize_resource (check-implicit); if/case role dispatch inside Ability (role-dispatch-not-literal; only send(user.role) is read); login helpers not named login/signin (actor-unbound); a fixture key bound twice in one file (actor-key-ambiguous, bindings are file-level not per-test). Expected: each common shape resolves or is configurable; UNKNOWN stays for genuinely dynamic cases (runtime policy is a recorded non-goal).
title: Actor-authorization analysis returns UNKNOWN for common fixture and ability shapes (fetch/navigation, load_and_authorize_resource, if/case role dispatch, custom login helpers, per-test bindings)
